decoys.sentence: Seller warrants that the sign will be free from defects in materials and workmanship for two (2) years after installation.
decoys.why: A warranty period is not a renewal-and-exit clause: it binds Seller and commits the buyer to nothing.

decoys.sentence: The price is fixed and shall not change unless Buyer requests a change to the work in writing and both parties sign a written change describing the new price.
decoys.why: A fixed price for one-off work sets no term, renewal or exit cost.

decoys.sentence: Seller shall carry general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence while performing work at Buyer's location.
decoys.why: An insurance amount is Seller's obligation and is none of the five clause types.

questions.question: What is the total price?
questions.sentence: The total price for all work under this Purchase Order is $6,850, which includes design, materials, fabrication, delivery, installation and removal of the old sign.
questions.answer: $6,850, covering design, materials, fabrication, delivery, installation and removal of the old sign.

questions.question: When does the sign have to be installed?
questions.sentence: Seller shall complete installation no later than June 15, 2026.

questions.question: How long is the warranty on the lights?
questions.sentence: Seller warrants the LED lighting components for five (5) years after installation.
